quest.title: Book in the Woods
quest.description: A little girl is hoping you'll play a game with her...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x100, Primogem x20, Adventurer's Experience x2

dialogues.speaker: Little Nine
dialogues.text: Hmm, let's see... The river carried me a long way, I know that. The water was really cold, it froze my hands stiff...

dialogues.speaker: Little Nine
dialogues.text: But I definitely didn't open it! I held it as tight as I could, because Big Nine told me how special it is...

dialogues.speaker: Little Nine
dialogues.text: Finally, I crawled onto the river bank. The first thing I did was find somewhere to dry the book out in the sun.

dialogues.speaker: Little Nine
dialogues.text: Then I was so exhausted that I lay down and fell asleep for a while. When I woke up, the book was gone.

dialogues.speaker: Little Nine
dialogues.text: It was in the woods over there that I dried the book out. You can have a look in there.

talks.objective: Find the lost book in the forest
Find the lost book in the forest
Go back and find Little Nine

dialogues.speaker: Little Nine
dialogues.text: Did you find the book? It's a really special book to Big Nine...

dialogues.speaker: Little Nine
dialogues.text: If it's gone, he will be sooo sad...

dialogues.speaker: Little Nine
dialogues.text: ...And if he knows that I lost it, he'll be really mad at me...
